status: ILLUSTRATIVE: every threshold below is a teaching example from the course roadmap, not a value tuned to a real product's risk and data

verdicts.SHIP: Every rule passed on complete, intact, comparable evidence. Exit 0.
verdicts.BLOCK: The evidence shows the candidate breaks a hard, quality or regression rule. No override. Exit 1.
verdicts.HOLD: The gate cannot ship yet: evidence is missing or invalid (rerun, no override), or a soft rule failed (a named owner may approve). Exit 2.

release.purpose: The production configuration: the strict backend enforces ownership and eligibility

safety_probe.purpose: The agent alone: the lax backend stores whatever the agent asks for, so this run shows what the agent would do if a backend check were missing

evidence.resolution: Rerun the evaluation. Nobody may approve a release past missing or invalid evidence.
require: both runs exist for baseline and candidate, and Week 11's verify finds no problem (checksum, schema, complete)
each run's config matches the policy's run config
baseline and candidate share case_set, data_sha256, dataset_version and policy_version
baseline and candidate hold the same case IDs, every one the suite expects

regression_gates.note: A slice takes the highest risk of its cases. With 2 to 6 cases per slice, one flipped case is a decline of 17 to 50 points.

missing_metric.why: Fail closed. A metric the gate cannot read counts as unknown, never as zero or as passing.

flaky_cases: A case's first attempt decides it. A flaky case counts as failed in every rate, and any flaky case triggers the no-flaky-cases soft gate.

canary.status: ILLUSTRATIVE thresholds, evaluated here on SIMULATED canary metrics

decisions.ROLLBACK: A hard guardrail breached at any volume, a rate guardrail breached at full volume, or max_hours passed without enough volume. Route all traffic back to the baseline. Exit 1.
decisions.EXTEND: No breach yet and too little volume to judge the rate guardrails. Keep the canary at its traffic share. Exit 2.
decisions.PROMOTE: Enough volume and no guardrail breached. Raise the candidate's traffic. Exit 0.

rollback.target: the baseline version named in the gate decision
rollback.verify: Rerun the release suite against the restored version and confirm its run_id matches the baseline's
rollback.record: Keep the canary metrics, the decision and the time of rollback with the release record
